summary: An undergraduate computer science reader who has studied algorithm analysis (big-O, recurrences, sorting, divide and conquer including Karatsuba-style multiplication), discrete mathematics (modular arithmetic, gcd and coprimality, the Chinese remainder theorem in its basic form, permutations, binary representation), and calculus and linear algebra through matrices, Gaussian elimination and basic vector spaces. They know complex numbers and polynomials, and have seen simple Turing machines with tapes. They have not met the fast Fourier transform in depth beyond its name, finite-field or group-theoretic structure beyond Z/n, Kronecker products, or any research-level multiplication algorithms.

known.name: Logarithms and exponentials
known.gloss: The base-2 logarithm and exponential functions and their standard identities and growth rates.

known.name: Floor and ceiling
known.gloss: The largest integer not above x, the smallest integer not below x, and rounding to a nearest integer.

known.name: Modular arithmetic
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers taken modulo a fixed modulus, with addition and multiplication of residue classes.

known.name: Greatest common divisor and coprimality
known.gloss: The largest common divisor of integers, coprime integers having gcd 1, and the invertible residues modulo q.

known.name: Prime numbers
known.gloss: Integers greater than 1 with no proper divisors, and unique factorization of integers into primes.

known.name: Chinese remainder theorem
known.gloss: For pairwise coprime moduli, residues modulo the product correspond uniquely to tuples of residues modulo each modulus.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Writing integers in base 2 and combining bits with XOR, AND and carry-propagating addition.

known.name: Positional radix representation
known.gloss: Writing a non-negative integer as a sum of digits times powers of a base.

known.name: Permutations
known.gloss: Bijective rearrangements of a finite set and their matrix form with a single one in each row and column.

known.name: Matrices and matrix products
known.gloss: Rectangular arrays of numbers acting linearly on vectors, with products, inverses, triangular forms and row reduction.

known.name: Vector spaces and linear maps
known.gloss: Standard notions of span, basis, dimension, kernel and image of linear maps and the dot product.

known.name: Finite field F2
known.gloss: The two-element field with addition equal to XOR and multiplication equal to AND.

known.name: Euler's formula and complex exponentials
known.gloss: e^{iθ}=cosθ+i sinθ, so complex exponentials of real angles lie on the unit circle.

known.name: Geometric series
known.gloss: The closed form for sums of successive powers of a ratio, including vanishing sums of nontrivial roots of unity.

known.name: Gaussian function
known.gloss: The function e^{-x^2} and its rapid decay, used as a smooth weight.

known.name: Basic calculus and inequalities
known.gloss: Limits, series, and elementary inequalities used to bound sums and errors.

known.name: Fixed-point and rounding arithmetic
known.gloss: Representing real numbers by integer multiples of a small step and tracking additive rounding errors.

known.name: Cartesian product and tuples
known.gloss: Ordered tuples of elements from several sets, indexed arrays on them, and their lexicographic ordering.

known.name: Cyclic groups and direct products
known.gloss: The additive group of integers modulo n, products of such groups, and structure-preserving bijections between them.

known.name: Sorting
known.gloss: Ordering a list by key in O(N log N) comparisons, including implementation by merging.

known.name: Divide and conquer recurrences
known.gloss: Solving cost recurrences of recursive algorithms and proving bounds by induction.

known.name: Karatsuba and schoolbook multiplication
known.gloss: The quadratic digit-by-digit multiplication algorithm and the first sub-quadratic divide-and-conquer improvement.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform idea
known.gloss: Multiplying polynomials by evaluating at roots of unity, multiplying pointwise and interpolating, with the transform computed in O(N log N) arithmetic steps.

known.name: Sums and indexed notation
known.gloss: Sigma and product notation, indicator functions, and basic set operations.
